Name: Agur
Summary: Agur, son of Jakeh, was the author of the sayings in Proverbs 30, a humble wisdom teacher who confessed his own ignorance before God.
KeyStory: Agur's words begin with weariness and confession — 'I am more brutish than any man' — then gather sharp observations about pride, greed, and the fear of the Lord.
LifeLesson: Agur teaches that wisdom begins with knowing how little we know and fearing the God who knows all.
